coin.title: Official Restrike: Florin d’oro Silver 1 ounce PF70
coin.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HCQNACX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}The Official Restrike: Florin d’oro Silver 1 Ounce is now available as a slabbed coin. PF70 is the ultimate grade – a perfect coin with no visible flaws, even under magnification. This restrike is a true masterpiece of minting, offering flawless beauty and craftsmanship. This coin is a treasure in any premium collection. Design The re-strike of the gold coin shows on the obverse the city arms of Florence, a Fleur-de-lys, with caption: ✠ FLOR - ENTIA; Firenze. On the reverse, an effigy of John the Baptist, the city's patron saint, with caption: ✠ . S . IOA / NNES . B. The re-strike will feature the year 2024 on the coin. This special re-strike also revives the origin, rich past and authentic atmosphere of our familiar Gulden (florin).
